owner_instruction: KUT production is authorized only from the 324 original FullMix LT-PIX SSOTs and only in this order: prove BLKs, CC exact KKs and contiguous KK-KOMBOs, verify the captured FullMix excerpts, add permitted KK/KOMBO headings, obtain owner approval, then derive mKs and then sKs.
reason_original: Near-perfect BLK/KK work requires complete source coverage, controlled uncertainty, and human structural listening rather than fixed-window or high-speed slicing.

now_allowed: complete sequential BLK mapping from each original FullMix LT-PIX SSOT
CC of an exact KK from one proven BLK
CC of an exact KK-KOMBO across two or more source-contiguous proven BLKs
post-CC verification against the original FullMix
permitted KK/KOMBO headings only after CC verification
mK derivation only after the KK/KOMBO inventory is established
sK derivation only after the mK inventory is established
still_blocked: use of INSTRO-ONLY or INO-PIX inventory as any KUT source
bypass or reordering of the mandatory production sequence
heading used to establish a BLK or boundary
duration used to trigger, generate, qualify, disqualify, or approve a KK, KK-KOMBO, mK, or sK
public release or sale without owner approval

production_authority.kleigh_heading_rule: A proven recurring chorus/title passage may display as Refrain or Refrain[n]; every other KLEIGH section remains BLK[n].

status_vocabulary.TRIAGE: Evidence exists, but the authority join, structural identity, boundary proof, CC proof, heading proof, or review proof is incomplete. Preserve the uncertainty; do not invent a timestamp or heading.
status_vocabulary.STAGE: Every required source, lyric, sequential BLK, boundary, CC, vocal, delivery, playback, and owner-review proof is complete. STAGE is never an uncertainty state.
status_vocabulary.HOLD: A deliberate hard stop for a known conflict, unsafe use, disqualified object, missing required authority source, or owner-directed stop. HOLD is not the ordinary incomplete-evidence state.
status_vocabulary.HOLD_NOT_BLK: A hard disqualification applied to legacy fixed clock windows so they cannot be represented as BLKs. A new authoritative BLK record may be created only after complete structural proof.

legacy_window_rule.promotion_rule: Never relabel a legacy window in place. Create a separately proven BLK record from authorized lyric and audio evidence.

romance_arena_authority.unlocks: Love Arena Romance pool under the same catalog-wide production authority
